Title: Start confirmed scheduled rides and switch phone navigation
Problem / Request: Connect a CONFIRMED request to the existing active or queued trip lifecycle without creating a duplicate request or reservation record. Preserve the request ID and addresses through reload and queue promotion, then hand pickup or destination to the phone's navigation app.
Acceptance Criteria: Fourteen reviewed exact patches are staged. A CONFIRMED ride shows Start Scheduled Ride, Navigate Pickup, and Navigate Destination. Starting is idempotent by Request ID and creates or restores one reservation-tagged active or queued trip state. The request app remains the sole Ride Requests writer. The dock navigation target is pickup before pickup and destination after pickup, including after reload or queue promotion. Completion retains the existing one-row Trips behavior and records Request ID, addresses, and route-derived miles in audit notes. mode=test is deterministic and no-write. This phase uses phone-native navigation handoff and does not claim embedded routing, background tracking, rider-status writes, fare, payment, automatic dispatch, merge, deployment, authorization, or production-data change.
